user.title: Singapore Weather
user.description: Enter your personal data.gov.sg API key and the private locations used by the lightning-near-home/work sensors. These values are stored in your Home Assistant config entry and are not included in the public source code.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Singapore Weather
reauth_confirm.description: Enter your data.gov.sg API key and private Home/Work coordinates. This migration removes credentials and personal coordinates from the integration source code.

reconfigure.title: Update Singapore Weather private settings
reconfigure.description: Update your data.gov.sg API key or Home/Work coordinates.

error.invalid_auth: The data.gov.sg API key is invalid.
error.rate_limited: data.gov.sg rate limit reached. Try again later.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Singapore Weather entry is allowed.
abort.reauth_successful: Singapore Weather private settings updated successfully.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Singapore Weather private settings updated successfully.
